adapter_selection: same predeclared stage2 qv_r8 seed42 fixed checkpoint as visual-budget diagnostic; no choice from formal validation or budget outcomes
input: unchanged image/question prompt; no reference answers, target text or OCR in model inputs
training: none; inference-only bridge on existing fixed weights
bf16_path: original unquantized backbone, vision and adapter BF16; SDPA may select a different kernel; independent numerical engineering path, not pure compute-dtype or weight-byte equivalence
uncertainty: 2000 paired image-cluster bootstrap replicates conditional on fixed weights; exploratory intervals, no multiplicity correction; output agreement does not establish equivalence
resource_rule: keep existing tasks running; admit one role to its GPU only after no compute processes and at least 40 GiB free, low utilization, on three consecutive checks; cooperative per-GPU lock; no process preemption
recovery: locked resumable prediction batches; each numerical path has separate cache and timing; no historical timing reuse
scope: single-seed internal dev numerical-path engineering study, separate from completed three-seed formal benchmarks; no new algorithm, formal-val strategy selection or production-throughput claim
